title: Multiple Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up, operate, or tend more than one type of cutting or forming machine tool or robot.

projection.title: Multiple machine tool setters, operators, and tenders, metal and plastic

tasks.text: Inspect workpieces for defects, and measure workpieces to determine accuracy of machine operation, using rules, templates, or other measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Position, adjust, and secure stock material or workpieces against stops, on arbors, or in chucks, fixtures, or automatic feeding mechanisms, manually or using hoists.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Read blueprints or job orders to determine product specifications and tooling instructions and to plan operational sequences.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Select, install, and adjust alignment of drills, cutters, dies, guides, and holding devices, using templates, measuring instruments, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Observe machine operation to detect workpiece defects or machine malfunctions, adjusting machines as necessary.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.

tasks.text: Set up and operate machines, such as lathes, cutters, shears, borers, millers, grinders, presses, drills, or auxiliary machines, to make metallic and plastic workpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Change worn machine accessories, such as cutting tools or brushes, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Set machine stops or guides to specified lengths as indicated by scales, rules, or templates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual fixture adjustment

dwas.name: Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Select the proper coolants and lubricants and start their flow.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Select production input materials.
Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Remove burrs, sharp edges, rust, or scale from workpieces, using files, hand grinders, wire brushes, or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Smooth metal surfaces or edges.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Perform minor machine maintenance, such as oiling or cleaning machines, dies, or workpieces, or adding coolant to machine reservoirs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.
Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Make minor electrical and mechanical repairs and adjustments to machines and notify supervisors when major service is required.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Repair production equipment or tools.
Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Compute data, such as gear dimensions or machine settings, applying knowledge of shop mathematics.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Dimension calculations from given specs

dwas.name: Calculate dimensions of workpieces, products, or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Start machines and turn handwheels or valves to engage feeding, cooling, and lubricating mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on production flow control

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of water, cleaning solutions, or other liquids.

tasks.text: Move controls or mount gears, cams, or templates in machines to set feed rates and cutting speeds, depths, and angles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Instruct other workers in machine set-up and operation.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Equipment instruction requires live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Instruct workers to use equipment or perform technical procedures.

tasks.text: Record operational data, such as pressure readings, lengths of strokes, feed rates, or speeds.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Extract or lift jammed pieces from machines, using fingers, wire hooks, or lift bars.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically clearing jams in machinery

dwas.name: Clear equipment jams.

tasks.text: Measure and mark reference points and cutting lines on workpieces, using traced templates, compasses, and rules.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking reference points requires hands-on measurement

dwas.name: Measure materials to mark reference points, cutting lines, or other indicators.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Write programs for computer numerical control (CNC) machines to cut metal and plastic materials.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Code generation strong; human reviews and integrates

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.
Write computer programming code.

tasks.text: Align layout marks with dies or blades.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.
